title: Kelingking Beach
description: A dramatic cliff with a narrow sandy bay — one of Bali's most-photographed views.

title: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
description: Famous terraced rice fields with panoramic viewpoints near Ubud.

title: Uluwatu Temple
description: Ancient sea temple perched on towering cliffs, famous for sunsets and kecak dance.

title: Tanah Lot
description: One of Bali's most iconic sea temples, accessible at low tide.

title: Mount Bromo
description: Stunning sunrise views over the crater and surrounding 'sea of sand'.

title: Ijen Crater
description: Famous for its turquoise crater lake and rare blue fire phenomenon at night.

title: Mount Rinjani
description: Challenging multi-day trek to the crater rim and Segara Anak lake.

title: Gili Trawangan
description: Popular small island known for beaches, snorkeling and a relaxed nightlife.

title: Gili Air
description: Smaller and quieter than Gili Trawangan, great for snorkeling and relaxation.

title: Komodo Island
description: Part of Komodo National Park — famous for Komodo dragons and marine biodiversity.

title: Padar Island
description: Distinctive viewpoints with dramatic, crescent-shaped bays and turquoise water.

title: Raja Ampat
description: Stunning coral reefs, limestone karsts and remote island scenery.

title: Lake Toba
description: Massive crater lake with Samosir Island at its center — cultural Batak heartland.

title: Bukit Lawang
description: Jungle treks to see wild orangutans in their natural habitat along the Bohorok River.

title: Tanjung Puting
description: Famous national park for orangutan conservation and boat-based expeditions.

title: Bunaken Marine Park
description: Excellent snorkeling and diving with abundant marine life and coral gardens.

title: Wakatobi
description: A remote marine national park with pristine reefs and clear waters.

title: Tana Toraja (Rantepao)
description: Distinctive architecture, cliff burial sites and traditional ceremonies.

title: Borobudur
description: Ancient 9th-century monument with tiered platforms and stupas — sunrise tours popular.

title: Prambanan
description: Large 9th-century Hindu temple complex with towering spires.

title: Dieng Plateau
description: Mystical highland with crater lakes, temples and colorful sulfur lakes.

title: Kawah Putih (Ciwidey)
description: Otherworldly turquoise-green crater lake surrounded by white crater walls.

title: Ujung Kulon
description: Protected peninsula with beaches, jungle and rare wildlife species.

title: Sawarna Beach
description: Less-crowded coast with caves, cliffs and clear water, great for surfers.

title: Pangandaran
description: Popular coastal town with beaches, caves and nearby green belt national park.

title: Belitung Islands
description: Known for unique granite rock formations, white sand and turquoise seas.

title: Derawan Islands
description: Great for marine life encounters, including turtle watching and snorkelling.

title: Karimunjawa
description: Remote islands with white sand beaches and clear, shallow waters.

title: Mandalika
description: Developing coastal area with surf breaks and scenic bays.

title: Selong Belanak
description: Long gentle beach popular with surfing beginners and families.

title: Nusa Lembongan
description: Calmer alternative to mainland Bali with mangroves and snorkeling spots.

title: Pasih Uug
description: Circular cove with a natural bridge and turquoise waters.

title: Wae Rebo Village
description: Traditional Manggaraian thatched houses set on a remote mountainside.

title: Labuan Bajo
description: Fishing town and departure point for Komodo National Park tours.

title: Mount Merapi
description: One of Indonesia's most active volcanoes with nearby cultural significance.

title: Mount Semeru
description: Challenging treks to the summit and crater lake in a dramatic landscape.

title: Baluran National Park
description: Open plains often called 'Little Africa' of Java with roaming deer and buffalo.

title: Bintan Island
description: Accessible from Singapore with resorts, mangroves and sandy shores.

title: Tanjung Lesung
description: Emerging coastal destination with beaches and marine activities.

title: Sibayak & Sinabung area
description: Region with volcanic peaks, crater lakes and alpine scenery.

title: Lake Maninjau
description: Scenic lake surrounded by steep hills famous for its sunset viewpoints.

title: Lake Singkarak
description: Long lake popular for cycling events and traditional boat festivals.

title: Sekumpul Waterfall
description: One of Bali's most beautiful waterfalls set in lush jungle with multiple cascades.

title: Tegenungan Waterfall
description: Popular waterfall with easy access and viewing platforms.

title: Jatiluwih Rice Terraces
description: Expansive terraced rice fields designated as UNESCO cultural landscape.

title: Weekuri Lake
description: Remote island with unique culture, cliffs and natural saltwater lagoons.
